questionPrompt: Read the passage below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
passageText: The technology has changed a way people communicate. In the modern society, many person rely on internet for informations. A government should invest in the digital infrastructure to help the citizens.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'The digital infrastructure' is correct here because it refers to a specific, identified concept.

errors.explanation: Do not use 'the' before abstract/general concepts. 'Technology' in general needs no article.
'The way' is more appropriate here as it refers to the specific manner in which people communicate.
'Society' used in a general sense does not need 'the'. Remove the article.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2: Technology — ARTICLE
